semantic_models.name: pharma_countries
semantic_models.description: Pharma country dimension enriched with its one-to-one sales region mapping. Countries without a region mapping remain available with null region fields.

entities.name: pharma_country
entities.description: ISO-style country code used by the Pharma marts.

semantic_models.name: pharma_products
semantic_models.description: Pharma package-level product dimension. One row per package code.

entities.name: pharma_package
entities.description: Package-level product key used by the actual-sales mart.

semantic_models.name: pharma_sales_actuals
semantic_models.description: Monthly actual-sales aggregate at month, country, package, distributor, control flag, sales type and business-unit grain. Negative values are retained because they can represent returns or accounting adjustments.

entities.name: pharma_comparable_cell
entities.description: Shared nullable month-country-brand-sales-type key used only to compare actual, budget and forecast at the same business grain.

semantic_models.name: pharma_sales_plans
semantic_models.description: Monthly budget and forecast aggregate at month, brand, source package label, country, sales type and data type grain. package_name is kept as a local dimension because its labels do not map one-to-one to package_code in the product dimension.

entities.name: pharma_comparable_cell
entities.description: Shared nullable month-country-brand-sales-type key used only to compare actual, budget and forecast at the same business grain.

dimensions.name: data_type
dimensions.description: Source scenario; bgt means budget and fcst means forecast.
